name: 54130 · Kaukauna, WI
findings: ZIP 54130 (Kaukauna) has 71 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54130 (Kaukauna) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: 5 hobby and sports organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.
